fact: The MerWat-Libya geospatial platform, built by FAO with the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, the Ministry of Water Resources and the Libyan Centre for Remote Sensing and Space Science, was launched in 2024 and integrates crop type, field boundary, basin and soil datasets for agricultural decision-making.
title: The Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS), FAO, and the Ministry of Water Resources in Libya Collaborate on the launch of "MerWat-Libya" Geospatial Platform, to Boost Sustainable Agriculture
